description: This file is a PHP script that appears to be part of the System module of a larger project, responsible for system information display and configuration. It handles configuration setup, checks for dependencies and extensions, manages language and template selection, and generates XML, WML, or HTML output with system metrics such as vitals, network, hardware, memory, filesystems, and temperature sensors.

classes.name: Error
classes.description: A class responsible for error handling, collecting and displaying errors during script execution.

classes.name: sysinfo
classes.description: A class representing system information, instantiated to gather system metrics.

classes.name: mbinfo
classes.description: A class for managing motherboard sensor data, instantiated if the sensor program is defined.

classes.name: hddtemp
classes.description: A class for managing HDD temperature sensors, instantiated if HDD temperature monitoring is enabled.

classes.name: XPath
classes.description: A class for XML data parsing and querying used for processing system info XML structure.

classes.name: Template
classes.description: A class for template rendering used in HTML output mode.

methods.name: makebox
methods.description: A helper function to generate HTML boxes with a title and content.
